run_infer_symbolic_types: run symbolic type inference on a traced module using two refinement passes
run_infer_symbolic_types_single_pass: run symbolic type inference on a traced module using a single refinement pass
build_unify_eq: build and apply unification to a set of equality constraints to compute a most general unifier
test_substitute_all_types: test applying a most general unifier mapping to all node types in a graph until fixed point
review_check_for_type_equality: review comparing type equality between two graphs node by node for convergence checking
